summaries.n-gta6-launch-coins: Coins named for Grand Theft Auto VI, which Rockstar Games released on 2026-11-19 (it posted on 2025-11-06 that the game would release on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and on 2026-11-12 that it was one week away). Forty-eight coins are members, thirty-five of them collected; each has GTA, GTA VI or a GTA VI place, character or in-game brand in its name or description: WASTED ("the iconic GTA death screen"), GTA6CAT, GTA Dollars, Ah shit, here we go again., gtacoin (LaunchLab), Macca The Gator ("GTA 6 Mascot"), State of Leonida and The State of Leonida, Peekhole ("a parody of OnlyFans inside GTA 6"), GTA memes, Jason Duval (it says holders earn $TTWO stock, which is not verified here), Rocco, EEAGLE, Doug The Frog, Jason & Lucia (it says it is unofficial), Official Grand Theft Auto VI (nothing shows it is official), GTA Vice Inu, Grand Trench Agency ("not affiliated with any game"), WANTED, Here We Go Again, and Bawsaq and a Vice City Index coin, named for BAWSAQ, the games' fictional stock exchange. On and after release day, coins named for other in-game things joined: five Apocrycoin coins ("Seen in game overheard on a boat mission"; posts of 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-20 say Apocrycoin is a cryptocurrency mentioned in a mission), two Founder coins ("The exchange for GTA VI crypto"; posts say they started from a "Fundador" badge seen in a DacityCoin screenshot), buckme and BuckMe Coin ("the Cash App of GTA 6"), named for BuckMe, the bank app posts call GTA VI's parody of Cash App (the buckme pool opened on 2026-10-08), PIPI ("PIPI the first meme coin in GTA found"; posts dispute whether an in-game PIPI ad is real), two Cool Dog coins ("the dog that saves every player in GTA6"; "Loosy, jet-ski dog in GTA VI"), and with them GTA Season, VICE 6 ("Vice VI | November 19"), OFFICIALGTA (Jason and Lucia; nothing shows it is official), Hugh Johnson ("one of the standout recurring memes of GTA VI's Snapmatic world") and Grand Theft Crew (StonkFun; "a GTA-inspired memecoin"). On 2026-11-22 two more joined: Leonida (LEONIDA), named for the game's state (pool opened 2026-11-22 03:44 UTC; posts say a GTA 6 PC recomp project shares the name), and GTV ("Get paid per view on your GTA 6 clips", pool opened on release day, 2026-11-19 02:20 UTC; the payout claim is the coin's own). Of the collected coins, all but Grand Theft Crew (StonkFun) are on Pump.fun. Dates from Codex: the GTA6CAT and GTA memes pools opened in late August 2026, buckme and several others in October, VICE 6 on 2026-11-13 and most others between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-20, so most launched ahead of the release on its hype. Archived (under $1,000 of 24h volume on two consecutive observations; memberships stay open): Mission Passed, GRAND THEFT CRYPTO, Cyber Dacity Coin, Vice City Bawsaq, the Meteora DBC Vice City Index, Leonida Games, Grand Theft Anthropic and, on 2026-11-21, EEAGLE, Jason & Lucia, GTA Vice Inu, Grand Trench Agency and the Meteora DBC apocrycoin, and, on 2026-11-22, gtacoin (LaunchLab). Coins named for the in-game DacityCoin/AudaCity brand are a separate narrative (GTA 6 Dacity Coin coins). The in-game references are as posts describe them and were not checked here; none of the coins is shown to be connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
summaries.n-gta6-dacity-coin: Coins named for DacityCoin and AudaCity, a fictional crypto brand that posts say appears in Grand Theft Auto VI. On 2026-10-11 the account @robtmb1 posted that a GTA 6 leak shows a meme coin called "Dacity Coin"; the first Dacity Coin on Pump.fun was created 35 seconds later. Posts since Rockstar's 2026-11-10 pre-load trailer say AudaCity boxes, a billboard and DacityCoin appear in its footage. On 2026-11-18, the day before the release, posts say a streamer with early access showed $DCTY as DacityCoin's ticker in the game, and a recap says $DacityCoin fell from $7m to under $1m while a rumour that the ticker was $DCI was fake; others argue the lore-correct ticker is still $DacityCoin. The most-traded DCTY coin moved over 50x in 24h and is quarantined, so it is not a member. Sixteen coins are members, seven of them collected. Collected, all on Solana: on Pump.fun, Dacity Coin (token created 2026-10-11), AudaCity (symbol DacityCoin) and DacityCoin (2026-10-15), DacityCoin with the symbol DACITY (2026-10-15), DTC (2026-10-20), DAC (2026-10-24), two DacityCoin coins with the symbol DCI (pools opened 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13), and, from 2026-11-19, AudaCity ("Crypto Metaverse/App/Platform of GTA6", pool opened 2026-11-18) and DacityCoin with the symbol DCTC (2026-11-19). Archived (under $1,000 on two consecutive observations; memberships stay open): two GTAVI AudaCity coins on Pump.fun, Dacity Coin on pons (Robinhood Chain) and three Meteora DBC AudaCity copies, and, on 2026-11-22, DTC, DacityCoin (DACITY) and the DCI coin at 85EzCV... Most have empty descriptions, so their names carry the claim. What the game shows was not checked here, the ticker claims are unverified, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two.

summaries.n-ni-hao-cat: Coins named for the "ni hao cat" meme after the trader Ansem adopted it. On 2026-11-11 at 00:24 UTC Ansem (@blknoiz06) posted "pfp up" and at 02:20 UTC "mihao pfp up.", with the cat as his profile picture; posts of the same hours say he bought the coin mihao and posted its address, and describe the meme as a cat version of the line "you met me at a very Chinese time in my life". Three Pump.fun coins carry the name: ni hao cat (mihao), whose description is that line, 你好猫 (咪好), described as "the zen master cat who said \"ni hao\" to Ansem and became his pfp", and ni hao habibi (HAOBIBI), a spin-off kitten. On 2026-11-22 Mihaomas (MIHAOMAS, Meteora DBC), a Christmas spin-off of the name with no description, joined; its pool opened that day at 06:35 UTC, and a post that day claims Ansem's "Merry Christmas" and "Mihao" posts mean "Mihaomas", which is the post's reading. Dates from Codex: the mihao pool opened on 2026-10-25, 16 days before the posts, so it did not launch on them; 你好猫 opened on 2026-11-11 at 00:26 UTC, two minutes after the first post, and ni hao habibi at 02:41 UTC. Some posts call the move a promotion by Ansem and question the coin's supply; those claims are not verified here, and Ansem's reasons are his own. ni hao habibi and 你好猫 are archived (under $1,000 of 24h volume on two consecutive observations; their memberships stay open). Measured: two coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-nvidia-ceo-scandal: Coins named for the Nvidia CEO story. The New York Times posted on X on 2026-11-08 that Nvidia opened an investigation into its CEO Jensen Huang after he acknowledged to the board a relationship with a business executive whom U.S. intelligence determined to be a Chinese spy. On 2026-11-11 The Wall Street Journal posted that Nvidia's board was preparing to oust him. On 2026-11-12 at 13:57 UTC Yahoo Finance posted that Huang had resigned as CEO and that CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO; a Reuters post of 2026-11-13 calls him the former Nvidia CEO and says the Justice Department has not concluded whether the businesswoman, Alice Huang, was a spy. Allegations are as reported in the posts and not verified here. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Nvidia, Jensen Huang, the petition or anyone in the story.
